domain.text: GitHub REST error diagnostics and concurrent assignee updates in the vmethod watcher.

impressions.text: The model delivered bounded, redacted GitHub error details and a retry/no-op path for concurrent assignee changes, with regression tests and green checks reported.
The first review caught a sanitizer regex that altered ordinary letters and a case-sensitive assignee comparison; the worker corrected both in round 2.

The worker stopped on red CI and asked for direction; the orchestrator identified a concurrent type clash from PRs #94 and #105, and directed the worker to wait for PR #117 before rebasing and rerunning checks.

roundCauses.text: Round 2 addressed the review's regex and case-insensitive comparison findings.

findings.text: The initial sanitizer regex matched backslashes and letters rather than control characters, corrupting “Validation Failed.”
Assignee comparison needed to be case-insensitive because GitHub logins are case-insensitive.
